_comment: Cards that exist only for the choose_permanents test (tests/unit/choices/test_choose_permanents.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_tragic` is Tragic Arrogance's shape -- four per-type marks into one binding, then a mass sacrifice that spares them. `t_flat_tragic` is the near-miss the DSL could already write: one choice of four over a merged pool, which happily keeps four creatures.

cards.name: Test Tragic
cards.oracle_text: For each player, you choose from among the permanents that player controls an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, and a planeswalker. Then each player sacrifices all other nonland permanents they control.

cards.name: Test Flat Tragic
